content_sections.heading: ACTREC Scientific Assistant Vacancy 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Candidates should download and read the ACTREC Jobs 2026 notification PDF carefully to check vacancy details, eligibility, age limit, and application instructions. The notification also includes important dates and selection process details. The direct download link is available in the Important Links section below. content_sections.heading: ACTREC Scientific Assistant Recruitment 2026 - Important Dates
Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for ACTREC Scientific Assistant Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the post name for the ACTREC recruitment?
faq.answer: The post name for the recruitment is Scientific Assistant. This is a contract-based position at ACTREC.

faq.question: Q2. What is the total number of vacancies for the Scientific Assistant post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy for the Scientific Assistant post announced in this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q3. What are the educational qualifications required for the Scientific Assistant role?
faq.answer: Candidates need to have an M.Tech or M.Sc. degree in specific fields like Zoology, Genetics, Biochemistry, Molecular Biology, Botany, Microbiology, Biotechnology, Life Sciences, or Applied Biology. One year of experience in cancer biobanking is preferred.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the Scientific Assistant position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Scientific Assistant post is 30 years. However, this limit may be relaxed based on relevant experience.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Scientific Assistant post?
faq.answer: The salary for the Scientific Assistant position ranges from Rs. 28,450/- to Rs. 35,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q6. How can candidates apply for the Scientific Assistant position?
faq.answer: The application mode is Walk-in. Candidates need to attend the interview directly with all required documents.

faq.question: Q7. When and where is the walk-in interview scheduled?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is scheduled for 27th August 2026 at the ACTREC facility in Navi Mumbai, Maharashtra.

faq.question: Q8. What documents should candidates bring for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must bring their Bio-data, recent passport size photograph, Aadhar Card, PAN CARD, and original as well as self-attested copies of qualification mark sheets, certificates, and experience certificates.

faq.question: Q9. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q10. What is the selection process for the Scientific Assistant role?
faq.answer: The selection process will be based on a Walk-in Interview. Candidates will be evaluated during this interview.
